context_requirements: Functional Hedgehog pathway with SMO expression and intact downstream GLI activation
Presence of GLI1/GLI2 transcriptional output or PTCH1 feedback
Absence of strong constitutive downstream pathway activation that bypasses SMO
Cellular context permissive for GLI-dependent transcriptional changes
falsifiers: No consistent directional change in GLI2, PTGS2, CCND1, MYC, BIRC5, CXCR4, MMP2, TGFB3, SPP1, or IL1B at 6 h or 24 h in any responsive line
No dose- or time-dependent transcriptional signature across the nine lines
Predicted up/down genes move in the opposite direction or remain unchanged in all lines
Response indistinguishable from vehicle or from generic stress/proliferation programs

changes: Removed GLI2 from proximal_down because SMO agonism should increase GLI2, not decrease it; GLI2 remains in proximal_up.
Removed MYC from proximal_down because SMO agonism is expected to increase MYC; MYC remains in proximal_up.
Removed BCL2 from proximal_down because Hedgehog/SMO activation is generally prosurvival and not expected to lower BCL2.
Removed CDKN1A from proximal_down because SMO agonism is not expected to induce p21/CDKN1A; if anything, proliferative signaling may lower it.
Removed CDKN2A from proximal_down because p16/CDKN2A is not a canonical SMO-repressed gene.
Removed GADD45B from proximal_down because stress-response genes are not proximal SMO targets.
Removed FOSL1 from proximal_down because AP-1 components are not established proximal SMO-repressed genes.
Removed ID2 from proximal_down because ID2 is not a canonical SMO-repressed gene.
Removed SOX2 from proximal_down because SOX2 is not a canonical SMO-repressed gene.
Removed CCND3 from proximal_down because SMO agonism is not expected to lower CCND3.
Removed TP53 from late_down because TP53 is not a canonical SMO-repressed gene.
Removed RB1 from late_down because RB1 is not a canonical SMO-repressed gene.
Removed CDKN1B from late_down because p27/CDKN1B is not a canonical SMO-repressed gene.
Removed GADD45A from late_down because stress-response genes are not proximal SMO targets.
Removed SFN from late_down because 14-3-3 sigma is not a canonical SMO-repressed gene.
Removed SESN1 from late_down because SESN1 is not a canonical SMO-repressed gene.
Removed TSC22D3 from late_down because TSC22D3 is not a canonical SMO-repressed gene.
Removed proliferation_down, g1_arrest, and apoptosis from generic_effects because SMO agonism is expected to promote proliferation and survival, not these generic effects.
Changed kinetics from slow to moderate because SMO agonist effects on GLI targets can be detectable by 6 h and are not necessarily slow.
Changed magnitude 6h from weak to moderate because direct GLI target induction can be measurable at 6 h.
Changed magnitude 24h from moderate to strong because sustained SMO activation can produce robust transcriptional changes at 24 h.
Changed line_response for A375 from weak to none because A375 is BRAF-mutant melanoma with no established Hedgehog dependency.
Changed line_response for A549 from weak to none because A549 is KRAS-mutant lung adenocarcinoma with no established Hedgehog dependency.
Changed line_response for HEPG2 from weak to none because HEPG2 is hepatocellular carcinoma with no established Hedgehog dependency.
Changed line_response for MCF7 from weak to none because MCF7 is ER-positive breast cancer with no established Hedgehog dependency.
Changed line_response for PC3 from weak to none because PC3 is PTEN-null prostate cancer with no established Hedgehog dependency.
Changed line_response for VCAP from weak to none because VCAP is prostate cancer with no established Hedgehog dependency.
Changed line_response for HT29 from weak to none because HT29 is BRAF-mutant colorectal cancer with no established Hedgehog dependency.
Changed line_response for HCC515 from weak to none because HCC515 is lung cancer with no established Hedgehog dependency.
Changed line_response for HA1E from none to none because HA1E is an immortalized normal cell line with no established Hedgehog dependency.
